note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace (42 mm case, Irsyad 2026-11-06); heights estimated for the listed 13 mm thickness (no side view). All dial print stays in the dial map. Strap: nylon NATO, photo texture, house 7 mm curl; keepers and buckle left out (they sit past the curl; Irsyad 2026-11-06).

seconds.note: tail hidden under the minute hand in the photo: 2.5 mm needle assumed

hub.note: cap = the dark pivot hole seen in the photo

lug.note: outer edge: straight line fitted to the traced edge from fit_from_y to the tip, down to where it meets the case; inner side follows an 18.6 mm arc, just outside the bezel's inner edge (18.43 mm), so the lug never shows through the crystal

strap.note: house curl (SUR419P1): 7 mm radius from the lug tips, end_y = tip + 2.2 R; built at final depth (heights x depth_scale)

steel_matte.note: bead-blasted case, lugs and crown as in the photo (no brushing lines)

lume.note: cool light grey, darker than the frame (photo about sRGB 185/184/198)

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers (model-viewer/three.js) render transmission from a low-resolution buffer and blur the dial

hand_steel.note: hands, hub, collets: bright white-silver with a cool tint as in the photo (frame about sRGB 220/219/245); rougher than mirror steel so it stays light in any viewer
